data.title: php调用示例
data.content:
<?php

new class {
    // 沙箱环境api调用地址
    private $domain = "https://sandbox-developer-api.vivo.com.cn/router/rest";
    // 正式环境api调用地址
    //private $domain = "https://developer-api.vivo.com.cn/router/rest";
    // 申请API服务后平台分配的accessKey
    private $access_key = "xxxxxx";
    // 申请API服务后平台分配的accessSecret
    private $access_secret = "xxxxxx";
    // 签名算法(当前支持HMAC-SHA256)
    private $sign_method = "HMAC-SHA256";
    // api版本
    private $api_version = "1.0";
    // 返回数据类型(当前支持json)
    private $format = "json";
    // 接口目标类型, 接口传包必须使用developer
    private $target_app_key = "developer";


    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->run();
    }

    public function run()
    {
        $data = [
            //公共参数
            'access_key' => $this->access_key,
            'target_app_key' => $this->target_app_key,
            'v' => $this->api_version,
            'format' => $this->format,
            'sign_method' => $this->sign_method,
            'timestamp' => time(),
            //method是调用的具体业务方法,可以查看某个详细的业务接口获取,eg：https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/342
            'method' => "xxxxxx",
            //业务参数: 可以查看某个详细业务接口文档获得,eg:https://dev.vivo.com.cn/documentCenter/doc/342
            'xxx' => "xxxxxx"
        ];
        $sign = $this->cal_sign($this->access_secret, $data);
        $data['sign'] = $sign;
        //调用业务接口
        $response = $this->send_request('POST', $data);
        print_r($response);
    }

    /**
     * 计算签名
     * @param string $secret
     * @param array $data
     * @return string
     */
    public function cal_sign(string $secret, array $data): string
    {
        ksort($data);
        $sign_array = array();
        foreach ($data as $key => $val) {
            $sign_array[] = $key . '=' . $val;
        }
        $sign_string = join('&', $sign_array);
        $sign = hash_hmac('sha256', $sign_string, $secret, true);
        return bin2hex($sign);
    }

    /**
     * @param $method
     * @param array $data
     * @return mixed
     * @throws Exception
     */
    public function send_request($method, array $data = [])
    {
        $curl = curl_init();
        $option = [
            CURLOPT_URL => $this->domain,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT_MS => 10000,
        ];
        if ($method == 'POST') {
            $option[CURLOPT_POST] = true;
            $option[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = http_build_query($data);
        }
        curl_setopt_array($curl, $option);
        $res = curl_exec($curl);
        if (!$res) {
            throw new \Exception(curl_error($curl), curl_errno($curl));
        }
        $info = curl_getinfo($curl);
        if ($info['http_code'] > 400) {
            throw new \Exception('Http response code is ' . $info['http_code'], $info['http_code']);
        }
        return $res;
    }
};
